goal: Implement deterministic, read-only format validation and MS01/MS02 regressions without modifying reviewed lesson outputs or adding AI invocations.

in_scope: Add parser-backed Markdown/YAML compatibility validation in scripts/validate_format.py.
Add positive/negative unit tests and pinned snapshots for 13 selected MS01/MS02 lesson/assessment pairs and integrated files.
Run format tests in existing CI, documenting limitations and runtime evidence.
out_of_scope: Change canonical lesson/assessment/integrated output, authoring skills, existing content validator or review verdicts.
Implement full Mermaid parsing/browser rendering, content selection, publication, auto retries, or a new LLM stage.

constraints: Stack branch on Step 1 PR #40; no automatic merge or publication.
Preserve previous reviewed artifact bytes and task fingerprints.
Pinned tests must reference exact existing MS01/MS02 commits rather than newest branch content.
CI passing is not human publication approval; do not claim unexecuted taskctl lifecycle commands.

definition_of_done.text: Non-mutating format validator identifies invalid metadata, code fences, unsafe URLs/HTML and local asset errors.
Unit and pinned Git-object regression tests cover all 13 existing selected MS01/MS02 lesson/assessment pairs and four module integrated outputs.
Existing CI executes validator and pinned tests without LLM calls.

acceptance_criteria.text: 13 pinned selected lesson/assessment pairs parse without editing originals; revised M01-L02/M02-L02 supported.
Negative tests cover unclosed fences, raw HTML, unsafe links, YAML duplicate metadata, missing assets and path traversal.
Existing author/assessment skills, legacy content validator and all reviewed artifacts remain unchanged.
Mermaid grammar/visual checks and unexecuted taskctl operations remain clearly marked out-of-scope.
